notes.title: Path 0.1007
notes.content:
- Added item enhancement function.

- Chest functionality has been modified.

notes.title: Path 0.1006
notes.content:
1. The Mysterious Path boss monster is summoned.

2. Fixed a bug that occurred in barrier crossing potion combination.

notes.title: Path 0.1005
notes.content:
1. Added dungeons and monsters.

2. The monster’s movement radius has been modified.

notes.title: Path 0.1004
notes.content:
1. Fixed a bug where players could not enter the dungeon.

2. Ore items have been added. (Can be collected with a pickaxe.)

notes.title: Patch 0.1002a
notes.content:
The direction of the game has been changed.

1. The dungeon entry method and form have been modified.
2. The tutorial part has been deleted.
3. The flow of game time has been changed.
4. The map size has been significantly reduced.

-------
Additional bugs have been fixed following modifications.

notes.title: Patch 0.1001
notes.content:
1. I have created a map that allows you to exit west from the northern field.
  - Chickens appear in the field.
2. You can make a broomstick with the wood entrusted by the carpenter Capell, and using alchemy, you can make a broomstick that you can ride.
  - Equipping the broomstick and moving while pressing the shift key will increase your movement speed.
3. Meeting the unnamed witch will result in being cursed.
4. Doctor Ditton opens a herb shop.
